## inspectSarif() function

Shows every finding, location and fix in a SARIF document, from any producer, without changing or judging it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function inspectSarif(sarif: object, options?: IInspectSarifOptions): InspectSarifOutcome;
```

**Returns:**

[InspectSarifOutcome](./sarif-to-comment.inspectsarifoutcome.md)

`inspected` with the view, or `invalid` for input that is not schema-valid SARIF.

## Exceptions

`TypeError` for non-JSON input or malformed options.

## Remarks

Messages are never shortened; only fix previews are, and visibly. No source, Git repository or host is contacted, so deleted source text is not shown, and inspection says nothing about whether the document can be published.
